name: Silver Thread: Deux
source:
Alicia Wilkershire is an exorcist who doesn’t fully believe in ghosts. For her, skepticism is a tool to uncover the truth. Hired to investigate rumors of a haunted theater, she steps inside… but what will greet her in the shadows?

[From [url=https://spicaze.itch.io/silver-thread-deux]Itch.io[/url]]
